tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Lists the places that have a What's on page on Zonori this week, with each place's slug, time zone and link.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Lists the public events listed on Zonori in a place, between two local days within the next 7 days, earliest first. Each has its start time and time zone, venue, area, how many are going, who runs it and a link to its Zonori page.

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Finds public events listed on Zonori in a place within the next 7 days, by activity (a circle's name or category, e.g. yoga, running, board games) and local days. Returns the same fields as whats_on.
